audit.why: FAV 6/10 fits 52.19% over 1642 games; Renekton owns levels 2-3 and the first-item window, levels 4-6 are contested, Volibear owns 2+ items.
Spikes recorded on both sides: Renekton 2-3, Dominus at 6, Eclipse/Sundered Sky first item; Volibear on Frenzied Maul stacking, Stormbringer at 6 (160/135/110s, disables towers) and HP items at 2+.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's slots were systematically mislabelled: Thundering Smash was called E in three places, a nonexistent 'Q dash' was invented twice, Frenzied Maul was called 'The Relentless Storm bite', and the Q cooldown was given as 13s.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q Thundering Smash (stun + auto reset, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, 300 range), W Frenzied Maul (5s, heals on the second cast, applies on-hit), E Sky Splitter (16s, 1200 range, shields him if he is in the blast), R Stormbringer (leap, disables towers). The Relentless Storm is the passive, not the W. Sky Splitter's shield was never mentioned anywhere despite being the thing that eats your burst window.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash is Q, 12s at rank 1; the bite is Frenzied Maul (W); Sky Splitter (E) shields him.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] headed 'Extend into his W heal' carried generic filler.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5s cooldown that heals on the repeat cast and applies on-hit effects, so his damage scales with attack speed and armour alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul heals him on the second bite, on a 5s cooldown.

edits.before: Your E-W-Q combo arrives before his Q dash is unlocked — E-in the moment Thundering Smash is down and the empowered W stun shuts off his W bite entirely.
edits.after: Your E-W-Q combo arrives while Thundering Smash (Q) is his only answer — E-in the moment it is down and the empowered W stun denies his Frenzied Maul heal.

edits.before: His Thundering Smash (E) cooldown is your trade timer — fight on its expiry and immediately walk back when you've spent your combo so he can't answer with his own CC.
edits.after: Thundering Smash (Q) is a 12s cooldown at rank 1 and it is your trade timer — fight on its expiry, then walk back before he can answer with the stun again.

edits.before: E-in, empowered W-stun, Q-heal is your cleanest window — Volibear has no dash yet and his E stun is short-range; run the full combo before he can bite back.
edits.after: E-in, empowered W-stun, Q-heal is your cleanest window — Thundering Smash (Q) is his only closer at 300 range; run the full combo before he can bite back.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 this lane becomes a cooldown-chess match. His Thundering Smash (E) has a 13-second cooldown at rank one — trade, walk back, and re-engage the moment it expires. Never step into melee range while it is up with your E already used; his point-and-click stun followed by a W bite with full lightning stacks is the only sequence that genuinely hurts you. At level 6 your Dominus grants enough bonus HP to absorb his empowered bite and his R's AoE damage simultaneously; pop it proactively to trade HP bars in your favour, Fury builds fast enough to chain an empowered W mid-fight. You won't solo-kill him easily here — he's too tanky — but you win the trade and force a back.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 this lane becomes a cooldown-chess match. His Thundering Smash (Q) has a 12-second cooldown at rank one — trade, walk back, and re-engage the moment it expires. At level 6 your Dominus grants enough bonus HP to absorb his empowered bite and his R's AoE damage simultaneously; pop it proactively to trade HP bars in your favour, Fury builds fast enough to chain an empowered W mid-fight. You won't solo-kill him easily here — he's too tanky — but you win the trade and force a back.
